title.en: The Instant You Raise an Arm

text.zh: 举手是个再普通不过的动作。可要让手臂抬到头顶，肩膀里得先有一整套接力。
text.en: Raising a hand could hardly be more ordinary. Yet to lift the arm overhead, the shoulder must first run a whole relay.

text.zh: 起点是肩胛骨。它没有牢牢长在躯干上，而是靠肌肉吊在背上，所以能跟着手臂一起转。
text.en: It begins at the shoulder blade. Rather than being fixed to the trunk, it is slung across the back by muscle alone — which is why it can rotate along with the arm.

text.zh: 肩胛骨外侧那个浅浅的窝，接住的是肱骨的球形头。窝浅，所以肩关节的活动范围全身第一。
text.en: The shallow socket on the outer edge of the blade receives the ball-shaped head of the humerus. Shallow socket, widest range of motion in the body.

text.zh: 抬臂的第一棒交给冈上肌。它藏在肩胛骨上缘，负责把手臂从贴身位置「掰离」躯干。
text.en: The first leg of the relay goes to the supraspinatus. Tucked above the shoulder blade, its job is to prise the arm away from the body.

text.zh: 接棒的是三角肌，包住整个肩头的那块。它一发力手臂就抬到与肩齐平，再往上还得靠肩胛骨跟着转。
text.en: The deltoid takes over — the muscle wrapping the entire shoulder cap. It lifts the arm to shoulder height; going any higher needs the shoulder blade to rotate as well.

text.zh: 如果你顺手把肘弯起来，出力最大的其实是肱肌，它藏在更显眼的那块下面。
text.en: If you happen to bend the elbow as well, the muscle pulling hardest is the brachialis — hidden beneath the more famous one.

text.zh: 更显眼的那块是肱二头肌。它鼓起来最好看，但除了屈肘，它还负责把掌心翻向上。
text.en: That famous one is the biceps brachii, the muscle everybody flexes. Besides bending the elbow, it is also what turns your palm face-up.

text.zh: 手臂后面的肱三头肌做完全相反的事——把肘伸直。任何一个动作，都得有人踩刹车。
text.en: On the back of the arm, the triceps brachii does exactly the opposite: it straightens the elbow. Every movement needs someone on the brakes.

text.zh: 一次举手，肩胛骨转、肱骨滚、四五块肌肉按先后顺序接力。你只觉得「抬了一下」。
text.en: One raised arm: the shoulder blade rotates, the humerus rolls, four or five muscles hand off in strict order. All you feel is a lift.
